t: This is the Criterion Theatre, a West End playhouse right at Piccadilly Circus. It's a Grade II* listed building, and it seats 588 people, so it's an intimate house for such a famous spot. It was designed by Thomas Verity, an English theatre architect who worked during the great theatre-building boom between 1885 and 1915. That boom filled London with playhouses, and the Criterion is one of the results, still listed and still part of the Piccadilly Circus scene.
